astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: PK 164 +31.1: The Headphone Nebula
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: What is a pair of headphones doing in the sky? Today’s image features the Headphone Nebula, also known as PK 164 +31.1 or Jones-Emberson 1. This planetary nebula, the remnant of a dying Sun-like star, faintly occupies an angular region of the Lynx constellation about 1/5th the diameter of the full moon.
